Hello BrightHome team, I ordered an LED desk lamp with dimmer for $30.00 on Nov 7, and it was delivered on Nov 10. Unfortunately, the lamp arrived with a cracked base, as I reported that same day. The damage makes it unsafe and unusable for my home office, so I am requesting a full refund of the purchase price. I can provide photos or return the item if needed. Please let me know how to proceed. Thank you.

Evidence: Minder's signed receipts #16, #17, #18 for this order. The PayPal order 40207127JC255074E carries the fingerprint of receipt #16.
Sorry it arrived damaged. We can refund 50% ($15.00) and you keep the item. A full refund needs the item shipped back at your own cost.
Refund of $15.00 issued for the damaged item. We apologize for the inconvenience.
PayPal refunded $15.00 to you (refund 0MF25057PD3625508, completed). BrightHome's agent sent it with PayPal's Agent Toolkit.

recommendation.reasoning: You should escalate because a cracked base is structural damage, not just cosmetic, and may make the lamp unstable or unsafe. The store’s demand that you pay return shipping for an item that arrived damaged is unfair.
